column1: # Findings `scripts/ci/check-evidence-commands.py` may not report, one per line.
# Columns: key<TAB>category<TAB>reason. The key is what the finding names: the path a
# command points at (not the document that points at it) for historical,
# recorded-absent and other-root; the command itself, as the finding prints it, for
# quoted-command. A row may only record findings of its own category, and an entry
# with no live finding fails as stale.
